title: Restore upstream split and side-by-side comparison modes
source: CyberTimon/RapidRAW, restored and adapted for RapidRoom
notes: Restores the upstream Compare button, right-click mode menu, persisted toggle/vertical/horizontal/side-by-side modes, and zoom/focal-point preservation. Pinned reference photos and virtual copies use the same canvas through read-only commands, including the existing MCP workflow. B remains the upstream compare shortcut; C is an alias, while A and navigation arrows keep their existing functions. Independent reference zoom/pan and side-swap from the removed wipe are not retained. Preview lens snapshots use the read-only resolver so entering original/split comparison cannot heal sidecars or migrate EXIF; normal photo opening retains its repair path.
